block_1_metadata.author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
block_1_metadata.role: Tactical TRPG sound effects catalog and audio cue dispatch definitions.
what_it_enables: Zero-latency SFX cue dispatch (< 5ms) for combat and tactical movement
Dynamic pitch variation for organic footstep and blade impact sounds
Cooldown throttling to prevent auditory clutter during flurry attacks
Bus routing to combat, tactical, and UI mixing channels
invariants: Zero dynamic heap allocations in audio cue routing (ALLOC_ZERO_HEAP)
All SFX cues must map to valid mixing bus identifiers
Audio strictly follows simulation events: audio never drives combat turns
